detail.longDescription: I have a project open in Delphi and I use the ChatGPT desktop app to make some changes to the code but it instructs me to close the files first in this message: Form1 is open in RAD Studio, though it appears saved. The project instructions allow disk edits only when the file is closed, and Kai’s editor tools aren’t available here. Please close the Form1 tab and tell me when it’s closed; I haven’t made these changes yet. Is there a way to leave the file open while editing ? What does "Kai’s editor tools aren’t available here" mean? And how do I make it available? I use Delphi 13 Searching for an answer I tried to search on Google using this ChatGPT "Kai’s editor tools aren’t available here" from Delphi I got a reply from gemini but none solved the problem; later search results use the string without quotes so there are so many results I checked several pages and youtube videos without getting an answer to my questions
